//: Example opencode config for CI. The only per-customer value is `audience` — the dashboard generates the exact string. The plugin mints the GitHub Actions OIDC token for that audience and sends it as the gateway bearer.

auth.//: subjectTokenSource=github_actions → the plugin reads ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL/TOKEN and requests an OIDC token with this audience. The gateway (Authorino) validates that token directly — NO Keycloak exchange — so the plugin must send the raw OIDC token as the Authorization bearer (confirm @vymalo/opencode-oauth2 supports a no-exchange bearer mode; the original sketch used grant=jwt_bearer→Keycloak, which ADR-0047 dropped).
